title: Final CAD/BIM feasibility: adapter replacement + end-to-end workflow (engine-independent canonical semantics)
objective: Earn the final CAD/BIM feasibility decision with reproducible evidence that the frozen adapter boundary is real, replaceable, and supports the defining ConstructionOS workflow. Prove a second engine-independent reference adapter, stable canonical Graph semantics, and deterministic model-to-version-to-quantity-to-estimate-to-RFQ-to-commercial propagation with Web/Electron parity.
acceptance_criteria: Reference adapter implements the same stable geometry contract without engine imports.
OCCT and reference results agree within declared volume/bbox tolerances.
Replacing the engine preserves canonical identities, revision semantics, graph event streams and downstream identities.
Graph mappings remain stable when engine GlobalIds change.
Downstream consumers import no CAD engine internals.
Model revision deterministically propagates through quantity, estimate, RFQ impact and commercial impact.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic downstream results.
Existing CAD implementation tests and new CAD-007 tests are reproducible in CI.
Epistemic uncertainty is explicit; reference adapter declines unsupported exactness classes rather than guessing.
No protected architecture paths are modified and Architecture v1.1 remains frozen.
non_goals: No production commercial optimization beyond the existential contract test.
No general CSG engine beyond the reference adapter exactness class.
No production estimate/RFQ services beyond the research contract.
No approval or verification claim by implementation.
risk_assumptions: CAD-006 is now VERIFIED against merge 74f95529; its verification cleared the dependency gate.
The existing spec/work-items.md roadmap numbering is superseded by the authoritative GitHub Issue #32 scope for this research gate.
Engine provenance may legitimately affect document content hashes; canonical Graph identity mappings remain engine-independent.
Mesh tokens are engine-local viewport data, not canonical quantity values.
The demo rate table is a fixture, not market data.
The reference adapter deliberately supports only its declared exactness class and fails typed outside it.
CAD-IMPLEMENT-003 PR #30 remains separate governance debt and is not modified here.
Architecture v1.1 is active and frozen.

evidence.description: 139/139 app tests with the pinned real OCCT toolchain, including 30 CAD-007 tests for reference conformance, identity stability, engine equivalence, swap semantics and impact cascade.

Deterministic cross-engine equivalence and existential cascade evidence: max volume relative error 4.162e-9 versus 1e-6 tolerance; max bbox difference 3.647e-4 versus 0.02 tolerance; estimate agreement 1.128e-7 GHS; identical event hashes and downstream identities.
Deployable Web and Electron proofs: Web real-OCCT impact cascade smoke; Electron reference-engine BrowserWindow impact smoke with 10/10 steps; host parity and persistence demonstrated.

Pre-merge final-feasibility CI on the exact tree later used by merge commit a382abb9: governance and CAD-IMPLEMENT-001/002/003 regressions all green; research-cad-007 run #3 / 33004559402 green with 139-test deterministic suite, Web impact smoke and Electron impact smoke. The merge commit tree_id is identical to the PR head tree, so the substantive evidence applies exactly to the merged content.

Post-merge governance verification on exact merge commit a382abb9: governance run #77 / 33005058022 completed successfully at 2026-08-26T19:25:38Z, validating the canonical repository after the final CAD/BIM feasibility merge. The merged tree is identical to the fully green pre-merge research tree documented in EV-004.
